issues.description: The Markdown does not contain the full marker/differential expression tables (Supplementary Tables 6, 7, 10) or per-tissue cluster counts; cell-type marker sets used in the original annotation are therefore not fully auditable from this text.
All 24 candidates appear in DGE, composition-support, or in situ validation contexts, not in the scRNA-seq cell-type annotation workflow; none pass the annotation-use gate.

Candidate cell types (B/plasma cells, T cells, hepatocytes, Kupffer cells, liver sinusoidal/liver endothelial cells, microglia) are outside the four PNS layers; the new scope requires retaining formal markers regardless of layer, so this was noted but not used as an exclusion.
